messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I hope this e-mail finds everyone very well.

I am using the non-smooth algorithm in the NMF library in R and was 
hoping to use the W of a training dataset along with the V of a test 
dataset to calculate H of that test dataset. If anyone knows how to 
execute this, I would greatly appreciate their feedback.

Thank you very much,
Eric
